info.title: Rocento Storefront and Customer API
info.description: Preview reference for selected implemented storefront and customer application endpoints. This is not a released, stable public integration API or a promise of third-party access. No public merchant API-key or machine-to-machine credential flow is offered here. Confirm access and compatibility with Rocento before integrating. Use the HTTPS origin of your provisioned storefront; rocento.com hosts documentation. Admin, internal assistant, agent and operational routes are intentionally outside this reference. The reference does not execute requests or collect credentials.

get.description:
Read active, unexpired, non-withdrawn messages for the server-resolved recipient. Initializes a server-minted HttpOnly inbox_guest cookie for anonymous visitors. Guest announcements contain no customer journey content. Read state is per recipient; signing in never merges guest history. No-store response. A supplied invalid bearer fails authentication; it never falls back to a guest. Customer ownership is derived from the session, never request data.

The server resolves the recipient from a valid customer bearer or a server-issued HttpOnly inbox_guest cookie. Invalid supplied bearer credentials fail; they never fall back to a guest. GET /v1/notifications initializes the guest cookie. Read mutations require an existing session. Guest history stays in that browser and does not merge on sign-in. Responses are private and no-store.

post.description:
Report an active product ID or slug after rendering its page. Requires an established guest inbox cookie (GET the inbox first) or valid customer session. In isolated deployments returns 202 after durable enqueue; the separate worker grants matching campaigns once per recipient; duplicate and concurrent visits are idempotent. Enforces audience, delivery area, start, expiry and withdrawal. Returns only newly delivered publication IDs. No coupon or customer identifiers can be provided by the caller. A supplied invalid bearer fails authentication; it never falls back to a guest. Customer ownership is derived from the session, never request data.

get.description: Evaluate published catalog relationships. Returns up to 20 available products with current shopper pricing and localization; Cache-Control: no-store. Source IDs are excluded, manual selections precede automatic matches. Segment membership is derived from authentication. Catalog price predicates use the published base price before customer promotions. End times are exclusive. Deterministic ordering within rules.

parameters.name: support_guest
parameters.description: Opaque server-issued visitor cookie used for admission when no decodable customer bearer token is supplied. It is not a customer authentication credential.

post.description:
Shared support admission over a 15-minute window: 20 requests per customer or visitor; 100 per direct connection source in peer mode; 2000 per installation by default. The installation total is configurable with PUBLIC_SUPPORT_TOTAL_LIMIT. Ingress mode delegates source throttling to trusted ingress; subject and installation limits remain shared in PostgreSQL across replicas. A customer bearer identity is used when present and decodable; otherwise the opaque support_guest cookie identifies the visitor. This admission identity grants no access: the endpoint still enforces its own authentication and live-session checks. Retain server-issued cookies for this installation; changing cookies does not bypass source or installation limits.

customerBearer.description: Customer access token issued by this storefront's sign-in flow. No public merchant API keys are currently documented.

customerRefresh.name: customer_refresh
customerRefresh.description: HttpOnly storefront refresh cookie managed by the browser. It is not a token to paste into documentation.

inboxGuest.name: inbox_guest
inboxGuest.description: Opaque HttpOnly inbox cookie issued by GET /v1/notifications. It persists read history for public guest announcements in the issuing installation; it never grants access to personal customer messages.

guestCart.name: guest_cart
guestCart.description: Opaque HttpOnly guest cart cookie issued by POST /v1/cart. Treat it as a credential; never share it.

supportGuest.name: support_guest
supportGuest.description: HttpOnly guest support cookie issued by POST /v1/support/session. It is separate from the guest cart cookie; retain it only for the issuing installation.
